highlights: DeepSeek 发布 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017，官方称其在推理、编码、Agent 任务与视觉基准上均有提升，并降低任务执行时间与输出长度；MiniMax 发布原生多模态 MoE 模型 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash，上下文窗口最高 1M tokens。
Liquid AI 发布 LFM3-Omni-2B，一个端到端的全模态小模型，可同时理解文本、图像、视频与音频并输出文本和语音，面向手机、笔记本等端侧设备。
Kornia 以 PyTorch 为底座的微分计算机视觉库提供 1,200+ 可微算子，覆盖相机模型、几何求解、特征匹配与增强等方向，正朝可微分视觉与几何的参考实现演进。

items.title: DeepSeek 发布 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 是 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的小版本更新，官方称其在推理、编码、Agent 任务与视觉基准上均有明显改进，同时缩短任务执行时间与输出长度。模型支持 Transformers、vLLM、SGLang 部署，并以 MIT 许可开放，开发者可直接取权重做本地或服务化推理。

evidence.quote: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash , delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks.

Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance–cost Pareto frontier across multiple agent harnesses.
For production use, we additionally release deepseek-recipe , a set of Rust libraries with Python bindings that provides the same prompt format as a maintained, protocol-aware toolkit.
This repository and the model weights are licensed under the MIT License .

items.title: MiniMax 发布 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 原生多模态 MoE

items.title: Liquid AI 发布端侧全模态模型 LFM3-Omni-2B
items.summary: LFM3-Omni-2B 是 LFM3 家族首个 omni-modal 模型，单个端到端模型即可理解文本、图像、视频与音频，并以文本或语音作答，从而取代单独的 ASR、视觉语言、LLM 与 TTS 模型。它按端侧场景设计，支持多语言、32K 输入输出上下文和 128,000 文本 tokens，可通过 Transformers 或 SGLang 在 CPU、GPU 上做本地推理。

evidence.quote: LFM3-Omni-2B is Liquid AI 's first omni-modal model in the LFM3 family: a single end-to-end model that understands text, images, video and audio , and answers in text and speech .
It is built for on-device use: one model replaces a separate ASR model, vision-language model, LLM and TTS model.
Small enough for devices: at 2.2B parameters, it is designed to run efficiently on phones, laptops and other edge hardware.
32K tokens (input + output)
128,000 text tokens
English, Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Hindi, Russian, Polish
Local inference on CPUs and GPUs, including a realtime speech server.

items.title: AI Agent 群体在 Minecraft 里建不出文明
items.summary: Y Combinator 与 Olam Labs 让一批代理在 Minecraft 中三小时内建设繁荣文明，结果是大量早期目标被放弃、群体陷入官僚流程，例如四个代理花 11 分钟为一份骨粉选定“唯一施肥员”。在对战测试中，GPT 代理与 Claude 代理对抗，Mindustry 对战由 GPT 一方以 6-1 获胜，这些群体实验已开源。

evidence.quote: AI researchers at ycombinator and Olam Labs recently tested AI agent swarms in gaming scenarios.
During this test phase, the researchers tasked 50 agents with building a thriving civilization in three hours.
After the first night saw zombies take out a large number of agents (but with little penalty) it was noted that “many ambitious initial tasks were abandoned.”

As an example, “four agents spent 11 minutes appointing a ‘sole fertilizer operator’ for a single piece of bone meal on a single wheat block.” The researchers say this AI agent swarm behavior “felt similar to patterns seen while working with coding agents.”
“The GPTs won 6-1 against the Claudes in the 7 games,” which was a great result for the OpenAI-created agents.
Researchers concluded that GPTs acted more like a hive, while Claudes had a single leader but a democratic-style decision process.
These swarms are open sourced so you can run your own, if you are interested in tweaking and testing.

items.title: Kornia 推进可微分视觉与几何的参考实现
items.summary: Kornia 是基于 PyTorch 的可微分计算机视觉库，提供 1,200+ 公开算子，覆盖相机模型、对极几何、最小求解器与 RANSAC、特征检测匹配、形态学等，多数在 torchvision 中没有对应实现。项目方向是成为 PyTorch 生态中可微分视觉与几何的参考实现与可执行规范，强调显式约定、一致性测试与诚实基准，而非继续扩张 API。

evidence.quote: Kornia is a differentiable computer vision library that provides a rich set of differentiable image processing and geometric vision algorithms.

📢 Direction : Kornia is becoming the reference implementation and executable specification for differentiable computer vision and geometry in the PyTorch ecosystem — explicit conventions, conformance tests, and honest benchmarks over API growth.
1,200+ public operators, most with no torchvision equivalent: camera models and
morphology, Lab and Bayer color, image losses and metrics.
Batched minimal solvers and robust estimation.

items.title: Drex Max v1：只输出概率的多模态决策模型
items.summary: Nace.AI 开源 Drex Max v1，这是一个 27B 稠密多模态决策模型，不生成任何 token，而是针对上下文状态与具名问题做一次前向，直接返回最多 255 个选项的概率。模型默认上下文 16,384 tokens，可上调至 262,144-token 窗口，Apple Silicon 上可通过其 llama.cpp、Ollama、Kapitsa 与 MLX 分支运行，另有 NVIDIA GPU 的 Python 路径。

evidence.quote: Drex Max, from Nace.AI , answers typed questions about a given context, in text, JSON and images.
Pass the context as state ( request format ) with one or more named questions, and get a probability for every option back in one forward pass.
Nothing is generated.
Drex Max is a dense 27B-parameter model with a 255-way readout head, and is released under the Nace.AI Open RAIL-M license.
On Apple silicon its text backbone runs on llama.cpp, Ollama, Kapitsa and MLX, and on the CPU with llama.cpp and Ollama.
The default limit is 16,384 tokens per request.
DREX_MAX_CONTEXT=N or --max-length N raises it up to the model's 262,144-token window (see context length ).

The backbone has 64 layers: 48 Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers that stay left to right, and 16 full-attention layers (every fourth) that are non-causal, so every token can attend to the whole sequence.

items.title: JEPA 论文声称 109M 模型超越 72B 的跨模态对齐
items.summary: Yann LeCun 与 Randall Balestriero 的论文从数学上论证，在一定条件下两个独立训练的 JEPA 可以学到相同的世界表征：一个从同一场景的不同图像学习，另一个从不同文本描述学习，且从未使用图文对。论文称该方法用 42x 更少训练样本达到同等图文对齐，109M 参数的文本 JEPA 在跨模态对齐基准上超过最高 72B 参数的 LLM。

evidence.quote: Post Log in Sign up Post Log in Sign up alphaXiv on X: "Yann LeCun and Randall Balestriero just Proved the Platonic Representation Hypothesis, and found a better way to achieve it.
So they mathematically show that, under certain conditions, two JEPAs trained completely separately can learn essentially the same underlying representation of the world.
One learns from different images of the same scene, while the other learns from different descriptions of that scene, without ever being trained on image-text pairs.
Their approach achieves the same image-text alignment with 42x fewer training samples than next-token prediction.
A 109M-parameter text JEPA even outperforms LLMs up to 72B parameters on cross-modal alignment benchmarks.

items.title: Nolan Lawson 实测 AI 生成前端框架的代价
items.summary: 作者用 PokéAPI 小型应用对多个 JavaScript 框架与元框架做了基准测试：让 Opus 5.5 以高 effort 按规范构建应用，用一致性测试套件校验，并统计开发时间、token 消耗、代码行数以及 Lighthouse 的性能与无障碍分数，每种框架取 5 次运行的中位数。结论是 SvelteKit、Gracile+Lit 与 Angular 的构建成本更高，但作者也强调实验随机性大、样本单一，框架之间的差距需谨慎解读。

evidence.quote: Design a small but non-trivial Pokémon app using the PokéAPI (those who have followed my work will be unsurprised)
Instruct agents to build the app with a particular JavaScript framework/meta-framework (e.g.
Test the output against a spec conformance suite (to avoid agent cheating)
Evaluate the results in terms of development time, tokens spent, lines of code, and performance and accessibility scores in Lighthouse
I simply gave the spec to Opus 5.5 with high effort and told it to use the latest version of the given framework.
For each framework/meta-framework, I took the median of 5 runs: in other words, I built the same app 5 times in the same framework.
However some reliable patterns do emerge.
Most clearly, SvelteKit, Gracile+Lit, and Angular are more expensive to build than the other frameworks.
